name: Ayush Jain
player_statement:
A complete player, Ayush Jain has made a big mark in cricket. With 116 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 51, with an average of 12.80 and a quick strike rate of 99.15. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 34 sixes and 131 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 128.1 overs, taking 60 wickets at an economy rate of 10.46. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
